body.message:
Unfortunately, after several maintenance visits, the problem has still not been resolved.

The sewage smell is just as strong as before. It is constantly coming through the AC, and I can no longer breathe comfortably inside the apartment. I am also experiencing eye irritation.

I believe your team has not yet identified the actual source of the problem. At this point, I am not asking for another routine maintenance visit. Please arrange for someone who is responsible for the building or a senior engineer who can properly identify and resolve the source of the issue.
